input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
input.rationale: The renewal term (12 months) and the uplift cap in § 8.3 (lesser of CPI and 3%) already match our preferred position, but the 180-day non-renewal notice window is well beyond the 90-day walk-away threshold and makes exit impractical. We shortened it to 30 days and added the Vendor 60-day renewal reminder required by the preferred position; a 60-day window is available as fallback.

ops.oldText: Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
ops.newText: Each Order Form renews for successive twelve-month terms unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term. Vendor shall notify Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days before the renewal date.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days and added a 60-day renewal reminder, consistent with our position that renewals must be easy to exit; a 60-day window is our fallback if needed.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days and add Vendor renewal reminder
